decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed extension, is acceptable because of its position, design and appearance, and would not harm the appearance of the property, the surrounding area or neighbours' living conditions. The development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension and 2 rooflights to front elevation of existing house.
